description: 95 distinct pending independent evidence/review packets. Cambridge lookup URLs are destinations, NOT observed evidence.

burmese_review.task: Independently check Myanmar naturalness, register and match to the same English sense; record evidence and reviewer.

example_review.task: Independently review original sentence grammar, collocation, exact target sense and readability.

cefr_review.task: Check sense-specific CEFR reference evidence; re-tier or quarantine if level unsupported.

audio_review.task: After text approval, generate both George and Emma files; listen to every recording and perform physical iPhone Safari acceptance.
